resources.string: The sound effect is drawn again in its translation, in the style of the original
Translate the whole chapter at once
As soon as a chapter opens, all its pages are translated in order, a few at a time, with no waiting on each page. Pages left unread are paid for too. Online chapters: as fast as the pages download

Each page is one request to the AI provider: it finds the text and translates it. A vision model is needed (e.g. Gemini Flash, GPT-4o-class, Claude). Translated pages are kept, so re-reading costs nothing.
